```json { "fixedHtml": "

\n \n Include Signature\n \n

", "explanation": "Added `role=\"checkbox\"` to explicitly identify the element as a checkbox to assistive technologies, resolving the issue of the missing role. Added `aria-checked=\"false\"` to expose its initial state (unchecked), which should be dynamically updated by the `toggleCheckbox` function. Added `tabindex=\"0\"` to make the custom checkbox focusable via keyboard. Included an `onkeydown` handler to enable keyboard interaction (e.g., Space or Enter key) to toggle the checkbox, which is essential for interactive controls. The text \"Include Signature\" within the span will serve as the accessible name for the checkbox.", "effort": "low" } ```
